posts.text: A review of antimicrobial resistance calls for AI-powered platforms to support and accelerate drug development alongside a community-driven approach that engages scientists, policymakers, health economists, clinicians, and patients. In PNAS Nexus: https://ow.ly/gwLt50ZHm7z

Correction: The previous image associated with this story showed a forest most consistent with forests during the Carboniferous and Permian periods, not the Jurassic period. The story has been updated.

This is what a Jurassic forest may have sounded like.

By combining exquisitely preserved fossil wings with experiments on living insects, computer simulations, and machine learning, scientists have re-created what they say is a partial Middle Jurassic soundscape. scim.ag/4cirWKy

posts.external_title: Synergistic degradation of fucoidans in the ocean - Nature
posts.external_description: Efficient degradation of fucoidans depends on complementary bacterial guilds that cooperatively break backbone and side-chain sugars, revealing a conserved, globally relevant mechanism that shapes marine carbon cycling.

Nature research paper: Critical zone processes limit alkalinity export from natural basaltic systems

go.nature.com/3SW42xS
posts.external_title: Critical zone processes limit alkalinity export from natural basaltic systems - Nature
posts.external_description: Observations from natural volcanic watersheds demonstrate attenuation of alkalinity fluxes along the complete reactive pathways from soil to river that lead to reductions in exported alkalinity, indicating the limiting effects of critical zone processes.
